note: Originals used by the mythology track (Stage 3). Built by scripts/build_course_texts.py into course_data/texts/<id>.json. Library passages apollod-3.14 and apollod-2.4 are used by id as well. apollod-epit-1.7 and apollod-epit-1.12: the Perseus TEI of the Epitome joins a few words across Frazer's milestones (συγκαταλέγεταιὡς, ἐπαγγέλλεται,ἐὰν, ἐμίγη.καὶ); after a rebuild restore the spaces (and the raised dot after συγκαταλέγεται) by hand, as in the committed JSON.

passages.title: Kronos and the birth of Zeus
passages.author: Apollodorus
passages.blurb: Kronos swallows his children; Rhea hides the baby Zeus in a Cretan cave and gives Kronos a stone in swaddling clothes.

passages.title: Danae and the chest
passages.author: Apollodorus
passages.blurb: An oracle, a bronze chamber, a shower of gold, a chest on the sea, and a king who asks for the Gorgon's head.

passages.title: Heracles in the cradle and at school
passages.author: Apollodorus
passages.blurb: Zeus in Amphitryon's shape, twins born a night apart, two serpents in the cradle, and a music lesson that ends in a lawsuit.

passages.title: The Nemean lion
passages.author: Apollodorus
passages.blurb: Heracles' first labour: an arrow-proof lion, a cave with two mouths, and a king who hides in a bronze jar.

passages.title: Theseus and the Minotaur
passages.author: Apollodorus
passages.blurb: The tribute to Crete, Ariadne's thread, the Minotaur, Naxos, and the black sail that killed Aegeus.

passages.title: Daedalus and Icarus
passages.author: Apollodorus
passages.blurb: Wings of feathers and glue, a father's warning, the Icarian sea, and Minos' puzzle of the snail shell.

passages.title: Hephaestus and Zeus
passages.author: Lucian
passages.blurb: Zeus has a headache and orders Hephaestus to split his skull with an axe; out jumps Athena, fully armed.
